title: VoteGA Georgia school district
schemaStability: Stable field names and meanings. One row per active Georgia school district. `districtId` is the state's own district code. A blank value is null, never an empty string; null board facts mean not yet recorded. New fields are appended, never reordered.

districtId.description: Georgia GOSA district code, as a string

type.description: county system or independent city system; curated, not derivable from the name

countyFips.description: 5-digit FIPS of every county the system is recorded as serving (joins data/places.json `fips`). Not a boundary: it does not say which district serves an address

primaryPlaceId.description: city place a city system is named for, where VoteGA covers it (data/places.json `placeId`)

districtCensusId.description: 5-digit Census school-district code; not a county FIPS

boardSize.description: authorized board seats; null = not yet recorded

termYears.description: length of a board term; null = not yet recorded

partisan.description: true = partisan board elections, false = nonpartisan, null = not yet recorded

officialUrl.description: board's official page; null = not yet recorded
